input.quote: Section 9.2 No Transfer or Lien by Depositor. Except for the transfer and assignment under this Agreement, the Depositor will not transfer or assign any Depositor Transferred Property to another Person or Grant or allow a Lien, other than a Permitted Lien, on an interest in any Depositor Transferred Property.
input.rationale: No non-compete, exclusivity or field-of-use restriction binds us. Searches for "compete"/"competing", "exclusiv", "solicit", and "will not engage/develop/market/sell" return no restrictive covenant, and a full read of Article IX (Other Agreements) and Article V (Depositor) shows only transaction-protective covenants: Section 9.2 bars the Depositor from transferring or encumbering the Depositor Transferred Property already sold to the Issuer, Section 5.6/5.7 are standard SPE existence and no-division covenants, and the Issuer's only activity limits are the self-imposed Permitted Activities in the Trust Agreement. The Section 9.9 risk-retention transfer/hedging restriction binds Cellco as Sponsor (the counterparty), and the Section 9.10 Cap Collateral Account covenant merely constrains the Issuer's exercise of control over collateral it holds for its own benefit. None of these limits the businesses we may operate or the products we may buy or build, so the clause set meets the preferred position (no non-compete on Customer).
